item.title: How (and when) to watch Alaska athletes in the Winter Olympics
item.description: The Games run through Feb. 22 and will feature about a dozen athletes with ties to Alaska.

item.title: Juneau Crimson Bears football will be featured on Super Bowl Sunday
item.description: NBC Sports released a short film featuring Juneau’s high school team and others across the U.S. in the lead up to Super Bowl Sunday.

item.title: Juneau man accused of killing Anchorage cellmate found competent to stand trial on murder charges
item.description: Both Fenumiai and his cellmate, 36-year-old William Farmer, were diagnosed with schizophrenia in their 20s. Their family members say the state should never have housed them together.

item.title: Perseverance Theatre postpones Anchorage run of spring show amid funding woes
item.description: Staff say the decision to postpone the latter leg of the show's run came after a period of financial pressure on the national and local level.

item.title: Allen Marine shutters overnight cruise company Alaskan Dream Cruises
item.description: Alaskan Dream Cruises announced Wednesday that it has ceased operations and cancelled all future sailings.

item.title: Trina Lynch-Jackson’s ‘The Briefcase,’ new Bartlett Family Medicine Gynecologist, Dr. Jes Young, Commission on Aging updates, and ‘Bees in Juneau’ photo exhibit
item.description: Juneau Afternoon featuring Trina Lynch-Jackson's upcoming talk "The Briefcase," new Juneau gynecologist Dr. Jes Young, Juneau Commission on Aging updates, and "Bees in Juneau" photo exhibit at Spice Cafe.

item.title: Juneau School Board continues to seek public input after superintendent application period closes
item.description: The search firm hired by the school district will use data from surveys and stakeholder meetings to narrow down the 19 candidates.

item.title: US Forest Service cancels plan to build Herbert Glacier cabin in Juneau
item.description: Officials say it’s due to staff capacity and challenges of the site, not nearby mining interests.

item.title: Local women bring ‘The M Factor’ menopause movie to Juneau, plus Juneau Jazz Fest, Mudrooms, and JAHMI Lookback film project hits the big screen
item.description: Juneau Afternoon featuring documentary film "The M Factor" at Goldtown, Juneau Jazz Week, Mudrooms "Sweet Revenge," and JAMHI movie event celebrates 40th anniversary.

item.title: Newscast – Friday, Feb. 6, 2026
